title: The best AI chatbots in 2026
summary: ChatGPT was the first widely used AI chatbot, but now the competition is getting fierce. Here's our roundup of the best AI chatbots currently on the market.
body_markdown:
****


**Best for**


**Standout features**


**Pricing**


ChatGPT


The best general-purpose chatbot


Deep Research tool and Agent mode for multi-step, sourced work and task execution


Free plan available; from $8/month


Claude


Writing and coding


Claude Code and Artifacts for working with real code and interactive outputs


Free plan available; from $17/month


Google Gemini


Integration with Google products


Workspace integrations and Canvas app builder that generates working apps via Gemini API


Free plan available; AI Pro $19.99/month; AI Plus $4.99/month


Microsoft Copilot


Integration with Microsoft products


Copilot Vision to "see" your screen and act with Microsoft Graph context


Core chat free; deeper Microsoft 365 integration starts at $9.99/month


Perplexity


Internet deep dives


Search/Research/Labs modes with citations by default


Free plan available; from $17/month


Meta AI


Social media


Unified chat, image, and short-video ("vibes") generation in one interface


Free


DeepSeek


Open source reasoning


Toggleable deep thinking on a free, open models stack


Free


Grok


X integration


Real-time access to X firehose plus Grok Imagine for images/video


Free plan available; from $8/month


Poe


Using multiple AI models in one place


Compute points and side-by-side/chained model workflows


Free plan available; from $4.99/month


Duck.ai


Data privacy


DuckDuckGo privacy wrapper that anonymizes IP/metadata before model access


Free plan available; from $9.99/month


Pi


Personal use


Short, supportive back-and-forth with guided topics in Discover


Free
